CustomField.description: TNCI-206 / ELV-DM-010; TNCI-139 / ELV-CPQ-036; GAP-01. Annual run-rate for the line. Summary Items and excluded products return 0.00. Ruby__NetSalesPrice__c is already an annual per-unit rate. For TNCI-208 eligible third-party lines, calculated OEM fee is a transaction-term amount and is divided by the prorate multiplier before it reduces annual ARR. This produces net-to-Tanium ARR without changing non-third-party line calculations.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ELV_Product_Exclude_from_ARR__c, ELV_Exclude_from_ARR__c, ISPICKVAL( Ruby__LineType__c, "SummaryItem" ), ELV_ProrateMultiplier__c = 0 ), 0.00, IF( ELV_Has_Tanium_Pricing_Schedule__c, ELV_Unit_Price_Variance__c * Ruby__ActualQuantity__c, Ruby__NetSalesPrice__c * Ruby__ActualQuantity__c ) - ( ELV_OEM_Fee__c / ELV_ProrateMultiplier__c ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Annualized recurring revenue for this line, net of the annualized OEM fee for eligible third-party products. Summary Items return 0.
CustomField.label: ARR Amount
